verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents low-effort ways to accept online payments: no-code Payment Links, a pre-built Hosted Payment Page, and a quickstart that completes an end-to-end payment. The sandbox has instant self-serve signup, but it uses simulations rather than real money, so nothing shows a live production account approved and taking real card payments within a day. missing for 10: evidence of production account activation/KYC turnaround time, explicit card-payment go-live timeline, independent or hands-on corroboration of same-day live acceptance.
